title: Quaternionic Nevanlinna Functions
summary: Nevanlinna theory studies the value distribution of meromorphic functions and provides powerful results in the form of the First and Second Main Theorems. In this paper, we introduce quaternionic analogues of the Nevanlinna functions. Starting from the Jensen formula due to Perotti (arXiv:1902.06485), we derive a notion of total order and an associated integrated counting function. We further define quaternionic Weil functions and corresponding mean proximity functions.
